      "observations": [
        "All 7,682 owned diff lines across 61 exact NUL-listed paths were read. This is a functional Graph generator, emitted-type and bridge migration, including changed fixtures and removed getters. Generated output is behavior evidence, not a manual style template. No Suite path or conditional product block was found. A materialized the diff but read no semantic body; C is the source reader.",
        "The generator separates supported object/enum schemas, emits owned public struct fields and removes PropertyMap/Cow accessors and nominal response lifetimes. Inherited objects flatten; fields use camelCase for named types and PascalCase for unnamed request bodies. Collection, nullable and reference flags drive different field wrappers. Enum parsing moves to derived deserialization. Schema-name borrowing, deterministic import and request transport families are checked in their exact scope rather than treated as new global rules.",
        "Typed response decoding now precedes direct field use. The new Required trait handles Option<T> and Option<Option<T>> with an explicit field-name error; annotations select the intended nullable implementation. Folder creation requires its returned id, while sync requires message ids/read state, uses empty preview text for absence/null, and preserves update-versus-create fallback only for the named not-found error. Some(empty string) is still present to Required; no nonempty-id validation is inferred.",
        "Change-read/flag batches filter missing returned ids and then reject a count mismatch. Copy/move batches instead retain their separate legacy-fallback count handling. Owned request fields use Some or notnull! explicitly, including DestinationId bodies and recipient email fields. These distinct consumers do not establish a universal provider-success or callback-equivalence claim.",
        "The Nullable alias can represent three outgoing states, but the documented presence distinction is not preserved by the actual plain nested-Option JSON input path. The paired serde_json null branch calls the outer OptionVisitor::visit_none, and skip_serializing_none adds only serialization attributes. The changed deserialize_user expectation leaves four explicit-null fields at their default outer None. Treat this as a concrete input-versus-output documentation/test boundary, not a reproduced network failure.",
        "DeltaResponse::extract_response drains the page vector with mem::take before callbacks, preserving next/delta-link state for later requests. The four changed page-value assertions test parsed data; they do not call extract_response or assert that a drained vector is empty. Existing operation-response typing and paging metadata analysis is reused without a second lesson.",
        "The notnull! macro is used both as a value constructor and in the extended-property let pattern. An absent property collection, absent matching property and null/missing value return None through separate guards; malformed ids or failed value parsing retain their own error behavior. The review's corrected pattern rationale is adopted in the macro documentation and concrete pattern consumer.",
        "Five changed assertion calls omit nonempty expected-result messages: deserialize_user and four page-value equality calls. Messages inside expect do not supply the outer assert_eq! message. Two unchanged assertion calls in rewritten extended-property fixture tests and the unchanged doctest assertion also lack messages and are recorded separately. Other unchanged adjacent URI/token assertions are not counted as newly introduced sites. This follows the deliberate message rule, not a defect based only on the word should.",
        "The original and accepted blobs match for 51 of 61 owned paths. The later accepted differences include generated Calendar additions, expanded FollowupFlag fields, a matches! flag test and request paging changes. Necessary current decode, required-field, sync, create-folder and batch consumers were checked separately. Whole-blob identity alone is not proof of unchanged callers or remote behavior.",
        "Rust 2024, workspace lints, generated role and bounded imported dependency roles were checked. New helpers and guards explain nullable disambiguation and pattern usage; the nullable presence comment needs its input limit stated. field_defs can use description.as_ref().map(...) before the inherited-reference fallback to reduce its local nested branch, but the current branch is clear enough to keep this a readability suggestion, not a functional defect. No unrelated formatter or naming cleanup is prescribed.",
        "Complete original team coverage is reused under its exact IDs: Parent read Bug 2047753 current description, comments 1–2, activity and end controls; C collected D299012 creation-to-final timeline, five actual inline bodies, one literal code proposal and one actual summary Old/New pair. This join inspects the targeted representation rationale and adoption concerns without a second whole-discussion read or independent-confirmation claim.",
        "The primary author weighs opaque-map allocation/lazy-error benefits against closer EWS composition, louder faulty assumptions and simpler extraction. Those are attributed design tradeoffs. The owned typed fields and earlier decode boundary are concrete implementation evidence; there is no measured allocation, performance, parser-crash or remote compatibility result.",
        "The generic notnull<T> function was an educational proposal. The author corrects the initial expression/scrutinee wording to PATTERN. The actual macro expands to Some(Some(...)) and the typed extended-property consumer uses it in a let pattern, so the source supports that narrower macro rationale. The code proposal is not adopted as a generic function.",
        "The request to document why nullable Required calls need type annotations is adopted in the helper's concrete documentation. The serde_with struct-attribute remark says it is already a dependency elsewhere; the later rebase adds this crate's explicit dependency and receives re-review. Approval alone is not dependency or compiler verification.",
        "One reviewer explicitly could not examine much of the extraction changes because of connectivity. Preserve that historical review limit rather than describing it as a missing present capture or skipping the generator source. C read every eligible owned generator/output change. The nullable decoding/documentation finding and assertion-message findings are separate static review observations, not concerns attributed to a reviewer who did not raise them.",

Current edited review replies are retained; unread older edited reply versions, linked dependency bodies and external jobs do not become inspected source or runtime proof."
